Featured project

Dadi ka Goal

A concept ad film for Philips EyeComfort LED. A girl invites her grandmother to play basketball, and a warm, steady bulb brings back the memories her trophies hold. The product is a silent character, never the hero of the pitch.

“Kuch cheezein umar ke saath kam nahi hoti.”
Started with a simple family storyA first draft about a child studying under a flickering bulb.
Found the emotionThe 80-second script with a false ending and the switch-click reveal.
Planned every shotA 27-shot storyboard with music cues, transitions and continuity notes.
Cut it to 20 secondsA silent version with only two text cards, finished as a storyboard for approval.
Event hosting

On stage at APEX 2026.

I hosted APEX 2026, the flagship Business Analytics event at PW IOI Bengaluru, in front of guests, student teams and a full hall, from the welcome to the award ceremony.

Guest at APEX 2026

Mr. Balkrishna Singh

A highlight for me was welcoming and interacting with Mr. Balkrishna Singh on stage. It was an honour to host such an inspiring industry leader.

The eventAPEX 2026, the flagship Business Analytics event.
The venuePW Institute of Innovation, Bengaluru.

My roleHost: welcome, guest interaction and the award ceremony.

About me

If it doesn't make you feel, it won't make you share.

I enjoy writing scripts that carry an emotion in the first few seconds, then shaping them into storyboards and decks others can pick up and use. I read a lot, I rewrite a lot, and I like cutting a long idea down to one line that sticks. I read, write and speak English, Hindi, Kannada and Marathi fluently, so I can write for people in the language they think in.
